test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

I was looking for a __barren seat__ in the bus but could not find one.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **vacant seat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"barren"** means something that is unproductive, empty, or lacking vegetation. (बंजर)

 
 
• **Example: **The farmer struggled with the barren land that yielded no crops.
 
 
 
• **"Vacant" **refers to something that is not occupied or filled; available for use. (खाली)
 
 
• **Example: **I found a vacant seat at the back of the bus.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "vacant seat" is the correct term to use instead of "barren seat".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **vacant seat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deserted seat **(निर्जन सीट): A seat that is abandoned or left empty by people.

 
 
• **Example:** The deserted seat in the park looked lonely.
 
 
 
• **Hollow seat **(खोखली सीट): A seat that is empty inside or has a space within.
 
 
• **Example: **The hollow seat was not very comfortable to sit on.
 
 
 
• **Vacuous seat **(अर्थहीन सीट): A seat that is empty or lacking in content.
 
 
• **Example:** His vacuous seat in the meeting room indicated his absence.
 
 

41:Tdb6,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**
